The absence claims (e.g., no located source measures generalization to unstored material) rest on a literature search conducted largely from abstracts, which the paper itself flags as its principal weakness.

scholarly_quality.concise_summary: A theoretical audit of the CLS analogy in LLM agent memory systems. The paper derives four commitments from the source theory, applies them to textual and parametric branches, and argues that neither instantiates the mechanism. The contribution is clear, the methodology is appropriate for the paper type, and limitations are handled explicitly. Main uncertainties stem from reliance on preprints and abstract-level literature search.
